$comment: Arena registry. One entry per PreStocks token that gets an Arena.
mainnetMint and devnetTestMint are left empty on purpose: both must be resolved and verified
at setup time and written back by the setup scripts. Never hand-write a mint here.
benchmark.coreFeedId is the 32-byte Pyth Core ID; a Terminal/Lazer id such as 1314 or 922 is
NOT a Core id and must never appear. Per-Arena benchmarks are supported by the program; the
current plan is the same stock benchmark for every Arena because most of these companies have
Duels are same-token only: both players stake the same Arena asset. A cross-token duel would
need the program to trust a dollar price for each token, and PreStocks markPrice is an
off-chain API value, which no program decision may ever depend on.

arenas.note: Built end to end first, per the schedule.
